title.zh: 美CFTC拟于12月15日召开圆桌会议讨论衍生品市场24/7交易机制
title.en: 美CFTC拟于12月15日召开圆桌会议讨论衍生品市场24/7交易机制

current_state.zh: The CFTC announced a December 15 public roundtable at its Washington headquarters on the feasibility of 24/7 derivatives trading, covering overnight sessions, asset tokenization, infrastructure and staffing, and continuing its summer consultation on longer futures trading hours and perpetual contracts.
current_state.en: The CFTC announced a December 15 public roundtable at its Washington headquarters on the feasibility of 24/7 derivatives trading, covering overnight sessions, asset tokenization, infrastructure and staffing, and continuing its summer consultation on longer futures trading hours and perpetual contracts.
